## Problem

Describe the failure mode or maintenance issue this change addresses.

## Design

Explain the responsibility boundary, public contract changes, and alternatives considered.

## Verification

- [ ] Unit or integration tests added/updated
- [ ] `make quality` passes
- [ ] `make acceptance` passes when runtime semantics changed
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when public behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or production payloads are included

## Compatibility and risk

Describe migrations, rollout concerns, compensation behavior, and any remaining limitations.
